subject.title: fix(update): keep managed gateway updates in the correct profile

question: Does the service-lifecycle owner approve making the stopped managed Gateway’s captured environment authoritative for all post-update fresh-process work?
rationale: The patch intentionally changes the identity and port used by an existing update/restart workflow; the PR itself requests explicit owner review and the protected label prevents automated cleanup or merge judgment.

options.title: Approve after live proof
options.body: Confirm the intended managed-service ownership semantics after reviewing a redacted real two-profile update and restart transcript.

options.title: Pause for lifecycle design review
options.body: Keep the draft open if the owner wants a broader decision about which managed-service variables are authoritative across platforms.

recommendation.title: Approve after live proof
recommendation.body: Confirm the intended managed-service ownership semantics after reviewing a redacted real two-profile update and restart transcript.
